feeds.title: Old World Garden Farms Blog
feeds.description: Our story really starts in late 2010, when we started our little 3 acres self-sufficient Old World Garden Farm just east of central Ohio. Our ultimate goal was to someday build our home there as well. We started a little blog called Old World Garden Farms. Our OWG blog has our latest recipes, gardening, diy, and farm update articles.

feeds.title: Petitti Garden Centers Blog
feeds.description: Our team regularly updates our blog with helpful gardening tips, outdoor living recommendations, and more. Our family-owned home and garden centers provide locally grown plants, lawn and garden supplies, home decor, and more at retail locations across Northeast Ohio.

feeds.title: Graf Growers Blog
feeds.description: At Graf's we want your plants to continue to bring you joy season after season. This blog is full of tips, tricks, and stories to help you turn your thumb green! We're a family-owned garden shop, landscape, and farm market company that has served the Akron area for over 39 years!

feeds.title: Strader's Garden Centers Blog
feeds.description: Latest announcements, planting tips, and ideas for your lawn and garden projects. Over 60 years ago, Jack and Ruth Strader founded Strader's Garden Center with just one small garden store on King Avenue. Throughout the years, the company expanded and now includes six retail locations and two wholesale divisions in the heart of Ohio.

feeds.title: Hook's Greenhouse Blog
feeds.description: Hook's Greenhouse is owned and operated by Charlie and Liz Hook alongside their two small children, Henry and Katie, with the help of a passionate, hard-working crew of expert gardeners in training.

feeds.title: The Groovy Plants Ranch LLC
feeds.description: Groovy Plants Ranch, your home for the grooviest plants on earth! We are truly passionate about horticulture, with a strong emphasis on exotic and unique plants.

feeds.title: HC Companies Blog
feeds.description: The HC Companies is dedicated to providing quality products that help to beautify our environment; from the Grower's operation to the Gardener's home.

feeds.title: Seed and Vine Blog
feeds.description: Seed and Vine design and builds beautiful kitchen gardens in Columbus, Ohio. We are on a mission to get everyone in Columbus growing food at home by giving people the knowledge and confidence to grow.

feeds.title: Obsessivecompulsivegardening Blog
feeds.description: Just about everything I do centers around the garden and it certainly keeps me in good shape. Gardening is a wonderful form of exercise for the body and the mind. Follow the Blog to keep yourself updated about flowers and gardening.

feeds.title: Gardening Haven Blog
feeds.description: Follow and be up-to-date with Gardening Haven's gardening tips and information blog. Gardening Haven is an Indoor and Outdoor Growing Supplies store.

feeds.title: Garden Center Magazine
feeds.description: Garden Center magazine supplies news and gardening resources on hot new products, good merchandising, gardening ideas, industry trends for retail garden centers, garden owners, nursery growers, retailers, and suppliers. Garden Center magazine is the leading industry trade publication serving independent garden center retailers in North America.

feeds.title: Stockslager's Greenhouse & Garden Center
feeds.description: Find the perfect plants for your Dayton Garden! Stockslagers Greenhouse and Garden Center specializes in providing the finest plants at affordable prices.

feeds.title: Horticulture Magazine
feeds.description: Horticulture Magazine is a bimonthly gardening magazine founded in 1904 that features articles on plants, gardening techniques, garden design and more.

feeds.title: Holden Forests & Gardens News
feeds.description: News and notes from Holden Forests & Gardens. Holden Forests & Gardens is making a positive impact in the region through urban greening and forestry initiatives, environmental research, nature-based educational programs, and world-class visitor experiences at its two campuses.

feeds.title: Dirty Blooms Blog
feeds.description: A conservation and re-wilding blog about native plants and the efforts of homeowners who want to save bees and other pollinators.
